checks.explanation: US CPI year-over-year inflation reached 7.0% in December 2021, matching the prediction made from the 6.8% November reading.
The predicted 5-6 year window (roughly 2026-2027) hasn't fully elapsed and no 1929-style financial crisis has occurred as of this check.

The opposite occurred: Manchin did effectively kill the original Build Back Better bill, but 2022 was a severe bear market (Nasdaq -33%) rather than a relief rally, and the Fed raised rates aggressively (multiple 75-basis-point hikes) rather than easing off, producing a hard landing, not a soft one.
